title: HLSE Email Verdict
description: JSON output of `hlse_core --json email [<header>]` — detects spoofing and BEC attacks in email headers and body text.

hlse_version.description: HLSE engine version that produced this verdict.

body_pattern.description: Social-engineering attack pattern found in message body (if any).

body_score.description: Body text attack score (separate from header score).

blind_spot.description: What HLSE cannot detect (score 0 and no body_pattern only).

pattern.description: Attack pattern label — either header-based (score >= 60) or body-based (body_score >= 60).

pattern_id.description: Stable SIEM/SOAR routing token (e.g. 'HLSE-BEC-WIRE') (present iff pattern is present).

verify.description: Independent check before acting (combined header+body score >= 40 — ALERT band and above).

cascade_risk.description: Other credentials and systems at risk.

confidence.description: Confidence justification — how many signals fired and their reliability.
